title: Truth was here before your urgency
summary: This meets the tightened moment when everything feels like it depends on your grip. The line breaks that spell by naming a truth older than your fear.
takeaway: Let older Truth humble the urge to control.
lifeApplication: Before you correct the room or send the message, plant both feet and say the line once. Let the age of Truth shrink the size of your panic.

source.shortMeaning: Truth precedes the fear trying to rule this moment.
source.lifeApplication: Before reacting, remember that Truth did not begin with this scene.

evidence.coreClaim: Truth precedes the fear trying to rule this moment.
evidence.turn: Truth is not won by pressure or wit, but by walking in Hukam.
